answer_1.quote: We ask LLMs to write corresponding stories of past experiences and commonsense rules given questions from commonsense QA datasets as input

answer_2.quote: We use perplexity to indicate the generation confidence of LLMs ... we employ an automatic evaluation to assess the accuracy of commonsense within the generated stories and rules ... we employed two scoring methods: commonsense scores and BERT similarity scores

answer_3.quote: we ask ChatGPT to determine if each story or rule aligns with commonsense, responding with either 'yes' or 'no'
methods: Prompted for yes/no alignment with commonsense

answer_4.quote: we conduct a manual evaluation of the generated stories and rules ... The annotators are the authors of this paper ... manually label each one for commonsense correctness
answer_4.guideline: A story or rule is marked as incorrect if it contains a description that contradicts real-world commonsense
